resolution: User shared screenshots of a keyboard model built in the studio with the fixed cut tools (vertex-mode slab with the cut grid + depth-coded corner dots, and the solidified keycap view) asking whether it reads as a keyboard / whether the keys are off. Assessed from the images: yes — rows and stagger read correctly, wider bottom-row and right-edge keys look intentional, corner-dot clusters sit on an even grid; the diagonals visible on each keycap top are the render triangulation showing through the edge overlay, not broken key geometry. Called it good to go. Q&A only, no code changed.
